description: Coordinate parallel Codex tasks in one shared checkout with a small active-only boundary board.

defaultPrompt: Help my Codex tasks move in parallel with less duplicate work and fewer crossed edits
Show me who is working on what and flag work that may collide
Coordinate this goal across the right existing tasks and keep each task focused
interface.longDescription: Keep parallel Codex tasks moving in one shared checkout without duplicate work or crossed edits. Codex Coordinator gives each task a visible, bounded lane, reuses related tasks before creating new ones, and stays lightweight—no background manager, polling loop, transcript store, extra worktrees, or required pull requests. An optional manual, read-only Doctor checks package compatibility and recommends update or reinstall when something is broken.

name: codex-coordinator
